statements: This was a passive run: it only loaded pages and read what came back, plus one request to a page that cannot exist to see the site's error page. No input was sent, so injection (SQL, script, command) and access control are untested.
Logged-in pages were not checked: nothing here signed in, so anything behind a login is outside this run.
Server configuration that isn't visible over HTTP - TLS settings, patch levels, secrets handling, logging - can't be verified from a browser.
The table below lists the ASVS 5.0 chapters: those a passive run can reach, whether this run tested them, and those out of its reach.
